user.title: Crestron DM Control
user.description: Control DM-MD8x8 routing and display power from Home Assistant. Power state is queried automatically. Standalone mode emulates the AV3 CIP endpoint so the DM can connect directly to Home Assistant.

init.title: Connections, names, and routing
init.description: CIP settings control the DM-to-Home-Assistant connection. In standalone mode, Home Assistant emulates the AV3 endpoint. DM routing commands go directly to the switcher console, and current routes are refreshed automatically. Input labels are editable; verify them against your room wiring.
